mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals economic weakness and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.
